title: ¿Se puede compartir el auto de forma segura?
summary: Una buen práctica es compartir el auto con otras personas, por eso te dejamos diez consejos para convivir de forma sana y segura entre todos los pasajeros.
body_text: El tránsito en nuestras ciudades es cada vez más denso y aunque estudios intentan demostrar que el problema no es la cantidad de vehículos en la calles si no la falta de cultura vial , bien valdría la pena reducir el número de unidades. Debido a las recientes noticias sobre la restricción en la circulación de autos con un sólo pasajero en algunas avenidas de la Ciudad de México, en esta ocasión queremos abordar una iniciativa que pocos conocen y muy pocos practican, la de compartir el auto . Esta costumbre puede ser realizada entre vecinos, compañeros de trabajo o escuela o con personas desconocidas por medio de aplicaciones que los ponen en contacto con total seguridad. Cualquiera que sea el caso, es una excelente práctica para reducir el número de vehículos en las calles, cuidar el medio ambiente y hasta reducir gastos. Beneficios de compartir el auto Primer hablemos de las ventajas que trae consigo compartir el auto con otras personas ya sean amigos, familiares o personas contactadas por aplicaciones seguras. Se reduce el número de autos en las calles Según estimaciones del Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía (INEGI), a diario circulan 4.7 millones de autos en el Valle de México. Lo grave es que un gran porcentaje de estos vehículos llevan un solo pasajero. Compartir el auto significaría reducir la cantidad de autos en la calle y con ello podrían disminuir los congestionamientos viales. Menor tiempo de traslado Muy relacionado con el punto anterior, si se logran reducir los congestionamientos viales, por consecuencia los tiempos de traslado serían más cortos. En el mejor escenario, este tiempo lo podrías utilizar para convivir con tu familia o destinarlo a alguna actividad física. Habría menor contaminación Estamos de acuerdo que la mayor contaminación atmosférica de la ciudad proviene de empresas y hasta de vehículos de transporte de pasajeros. La pregunta aquí es ¿si podemos hacer algo para reducir la contaminación, por qué no hacerlo? A menor número de vehículos menores emisiones de gases contaminantes. Reducir los gastos del auto La principal razón para compartir auto es reducir los gastos del auto . Si compartes tu vehículo con amigos, familiares o compañeros de trabajo pueden dividir gastos de gasolina , estacionamiento y podrían ayudarte con un porcentaje en el gasto de los servicios. Tienes un viaje más ameno Ya mencionamos que a menor número de autos, menores congestionamientos y menor estrés. Pero está demostrado que al viajar acompañado, reduce el estrés al conducir. Una buena conversación con amigos o compañeros de trabajo puede ser bienvenida durante un viaje largo después de la jornada laboral. Además, puedes mejorar las relaciones con tus amigos y/o familiares. Consejos para compartir el auto Si te animas a realizar esta práctica con la que además puedes conocer nuevas personas o convivir más con tus familiares y amigos, te dejamos algunos consejos útiles que te pueden servir para viajar más seguro y cómodo. Acuerda turnos de transporte Si viajas con amigos o familiares, acuerda los días que le corresponderá a cada quien llevar a los demás. Es muy importante que sea equitativo en todo momento sin importar que se trate de un familiar. Una diferencia entre los días que le corresponde a cada unos transportar a los demás puede llevar a que el acuerdo de compartir auto llegue a su fin. Conduce de forma segura Ser un buen conductor es muy importante para compartir tu auto con alguien más. Frenar o acelerar bruscamente o bien acelerar de más, puedes hacer sentir a los demá inseguros. Establecer rutas y horarios Es mejor que se propongan y respeten horarios y lugares en donde se van a recoger a las personas para evitar atrasos en los viajes . Este consejo es más importante si se van a hacer más de dos paradas para recoger a alguien. Llega a un acuerdo con tus vecinos, amigos o quien vaya a viajar contigo para ser puntual y precisos sobre los horarios y puntos de partida. Dependiendo de las personas con quien compartas el auto y sus rutas puede ocurrir que no todas lleguen a su destino preciso. Pero procura dejarlos en el punto más cercano y claro la otra persona debe de estar de acuerdo. No llegar a tu destino y tener que caminar o usar transporte, puede ser una situación desalentadora para compartir el auto pero recuerda que aún existe la ventaja del ahorro en los gastos, reducción de vehículos, además de la convivencia con otras personas. Determinar medios de comunicación Ya sea si utilizas aplicaciones o no, intercambia modos de contacto entre todas las personas que viajarán en el auto y establezcan rutas alternativas para solucionar contingencias. Mantén en buen estado tu auto Si eres el conductor procura mantener a tu auto funcionando de buena forma y tus papeles como licencia o seguro en regla y vigentes. Además, establece con los demás si en cada viaje se pasará a cargar gasolina o debes hacerlo desde un viaje anterior. Comportamiento dentro del auto En el momento en que se determinen horarios y lugares de partida, tomen un tiempo para establecer ciertas normas de convivencia en el auto , a fin de mantener en todo momento un ambiente sano. Es importante que antes de iniciar el viaje, quede claro si se va escuchar música, qué tipo de música y a qué volumen , de preferencia es en un volumen bajo pero entre todos lo deben de acordar. De igual forma es importante decidir sobre si será o no posible comer dentro del auto, los asientos y espacio de los mismos que cada persona tiene designado, si será o no posible fumar y hasta qué temas de conversión no son agradables para los ocupantes. Sé que puede sonar a mucho pero es muy común que después de cierto tiempo la convivencia dentro del vehículo se vuelva difícil por no aclarar desde un principio estos puntos. Mantén tu auto limpio Si eres el conductor, procura siempre tener el auto limpio y libre de malos olores. Te compartimos una "Guía para mantener limpio el interior de tu auto". Si eres uno de los pasajeros, siempre recoge al final del viaje la basura que pudieras dejar, así como procura no llevar demasiada tierra o lodo en tus zapatos. Evita paradas innecesarias Compartir un auto significa el compromiso de respetar el tiempo del otro por eso la necesidad de ser puntual y la de evitar a toda costa retrasos con paradas que los desvíen de su camino. Respetar a los compañeros En todo momento es importante dirigirse a los demás con respeto y de una forma amable . Por muy sociables que seamos debemos entender que habrá personas a quienes no les guste platicar durante el viaje. Dividir los gastos del viaje La razón fundamental para compartir el auto, es la de ahorrar gastos, por eso establezcan desde un inicio los gastos y porcentajes de los mimos que cubrirá cada uno. Lo ideal es que el total de los gastos de gasolina, casetas en caso de viajes y demás, se dividan entre todos. Usar aplicaciones para compartir auto Este punto requiere su mención aparte pues compartir tu auto con personas extrañas es más complejo y puede ser muy atemorizante. Para hacerlo con total confianza y seguridad puedes hacer uso de aplicaciones como Waze Carpool o BlaBlaCar. En estos sistemas puedes ir calificando a los pasajeros y posibles conductores con los cuales vayas a viajar. Además de ayudar a conectar a personas que frecuenten las mismas rutas, muchas de estas aplicaciones permiten filtrar si deseas buscar conductor y/o viajar con hombres o mujeres. Con estos pequeños consejos podrás tener una sana convivencia con quienes decidas compartir tu auto. También puedes hacer uso de aplicaciones que te permiten contactar con otras personas que se transporta a lugares cercanos a tu destino. ¿Quieres comprar tu auto? hazlo con un arrendamiento automotriz . title: AI Outbound Calling: How Modern Sales Teams Use AI to Book More Meetings Without Burning Out SDRs
summary: Discover how AI outbound calling combines intelligent dialing, AI voice agents, and real time coaching to help SDRs book more meetings and scale outbound sales.
body_text: A typical SDR spends hours dialing numbers, leaving voicemails, navigating receptionists, logging call outcomes, updating CRM records, switching between browser tabs, and hearing "I'm busy" dozens of times before finding someone willing to have a conversation. Even highly motivated representatives eventually feel the mental fatigue that comes with repeating the same routine hundreds of times every week. Bottom line: it’s called the burnout factor, and it’s very common, regardless of whether you’re a sales rep or anyone else working a job. We’re all humans, and we get tired of the mundane processes , if there aren’t any smart solutions to escalate the overall output. To keep things on point, sales managers responsible for heading different SDR teams see the symptoms everywhere. How so? For starters, they’ve been there during the early stages of their career, alluding to the fact that they’ve faced similar challenges and have overcome them efficiently. Particularly speaking about the overall slow pace, there are a lot of things that impact stuff in a loop shape. Normally, we see the hiring process taking longer than expected. Then you have to factor in the ramp time, as in training those reps and bringing them up to speed, in terms of whatever products they’re going to be selling, scripts, max time to spend on each call and vice versa. There’s a lot that could go into the training factor. But to keep things on point, if you are looking for budget based hiring, then expert SDRs are definitely going to come onboard with a higher payroll requirement. Usually, businesses want to keep the expense side of things low, so budget underlines decision making process and impacts how things eventually pan out. At some point, simply asking people to work harder stops producing better results. This is exactly why AI outbound calling has become one of the biggest conversations in modern revenue teams. It is changing far more than the way calls are placed. It is changing how outbound sales is designed from the ground up. Rather than asking one SDR to manually complete one hundred phone calls every day, companies can now let intelligent systems handle repetitive conversations while human sellers spend more time speaking with prospects who already have genuine interest. That changes everything in a lot of ways. Sales teams are discovering that AI powered voice calling for sales creates opportunities that were almost impossible only a few years ago. Large prospect lists become manageable. Response times shrink dramatically. Representatives spend less time performing repetitive work and more time building relationships that close revenue. The conversation has moved far beyond simple automation. Modern platforms now combine Intelligent phone dialing and calling systems , Automated call handling and routing , Real time call coaching and guidance , and highly capable AI voice agents and virtual sales assistants into one connected outbound workflow. Those capabilities allow organizations to scale conversations without sacrificing quality. That naturally leads to an important question many revenue leaders are asking. How do modern sales teams use AI to book more meetings without burning out SDRs? The answer has very little to do with replacing people. More robust organizations are giving repetitive activities to AI while allowing experienced sales professionals to spend their energy where humans create the greatest value. Throughout this series, we'll walk through every stage of that process, beginning with the biggest reason traditional outbound prospecting struggles today. Why Traditional Outbound Is Becoming Harder Every Year? That’s a very common question that circulates the industry way more frequently than you’d anticipate. Outbound sales have never been easy. With a higher call volume, and a naturally ocurring low cold call conversion rate, a lot has to go into the planning and exrcution phase behind each call. On top of that, SDRs are on a time crunch, so there’s only a specific amount of time they can allocate to the call + conversion ratio. Does the time spent on research part count? No, not really. Your manager may acknowledge the fact that you, as an SDR, do due diligence on pulling up research concerning prospects’ pain points, but at the end of the day, it’s the conversion that matters. And it also impacts your sales closing goals, quota and overall incentivization system. Low closure will eventually result in a lay off. But that’s also part of the game because SDRs end up learning stuff before they start applying for a new role in another company. Cold calling has always required persistence, resilience, confidence, and a willingness to hear rejection over and over again. The difference today is that nearly every obstacle has become larger. Buyers receive more emails than ever. Phone numbers are screened. Spam filters continue improving. Receptionists receive better training. Decision makers protect their calendars much more aggressively than they did several years ago. All of that means SDRs have to work significantly harder just to create the same number of conversations. The frustrating part is that most of an SDR's work never involves selling. Think about what happens during a typical workday. A representative opens the CRM, reviews a prospect list, copies contact information, launches the dialer, waits for the connection, reaches voicemail, leaves a message, updates the record, schedules another follow up, moves to the next prospect, and repeats that cycle dozens of times. Hours disappear before meaningful conversations even begin. The workload feels productive because there is constant activity. Unfortunately, activity and pipeline are very different things. Many organizations still evaluate SDR performance through numbers like daily dials or emails sent. More Activity Does Not Always Create More Pipeline Imagine two different SDRs. The first representative manually places one hundred calls throughout the day. The second representative spends almost the entire day speaking with qualified prospects because repetitive work has already been handled through AI outbound calling . Both employees worked eight hours. One generated activity. The other generated conversations. Revenue teams care about conversations. That difference becomes even larger once companies begin adopting AI powered voice calling for sales across multiple territories. Rather than increasing headcount every quarter, organizations can dramatically increase outbound capacity while allowing experienced sellers to spend their time on higher value interactions. That creates a healthier balance across the entire sales organization. Burnout Is Expensive Long Before Someone Resigns Burnout rarely happens overnight. It builds slowly. Representatives begin losing enthusiasm. Call quality becomes inconsistent. Follow ups become less personalized. Confidence slowly disappears. Managers spend more time coaching mindset than improving sales skills. Eventually many talented SDRs begin searching for another opportunity. Replacing them creates another round of recruiting, onboarding, product training, coaching sessions, and several months before new hires become fully productive. Every departure costs much more than another salary. Automated Call Handling and Routing Creates Faster Conversations, Not More Robotic Ones One of the biggest misconceptions about AI in outbound sales is that it simply places more phone calls. That would be a fairly small improvement. Modern Automated call handling and routing changes almost every stage of the outbound process before a sales representative even joins the conversation. Think about how much time disappears during a normal calling session. An SDR dials the number, but the prospect does not answer. The call reaches voicemail. Another number connects to a receptionist. The receptionist transfers the call. The line disconnects. Someone answers but asks for a callback. The representative updates the CRM before moving to the next contact. None of those activities generate revenue. They simply consume time. Modern AI handles those repetitive interactions automatically, allowing sales representatives to spend far more of their day having conversations with people who are ready to engage. The improvement goes much deeper than placing calls faster. Every interaction becomes part of an intelligent workflow that decides what should happen next without requiring manual intervention. AI Understands What Happens During Every Call Traditional dialers treated every phone call exactly the same. A number was dialed; someone answered, or they did not. The representative handled everything from that point onward. Today's Intelligent phone dialing and calling systems understand what is happening throughout the conversation. They recognize different call outcomes almost immediately. For example, the system can identify several situations within seconds. • A voicemail answers the phone • A receptionist or gatekeeper answers • The prospect answers directly • The number is disconnected • The prospect requests another call later • The conversation qualifies for an immediate transfer Every one of those outcomes triggers a different action automatically. There is no need for the SDR to stop, make decisions, update notes, or remember follow up schedules. The system keeps the workflow moving while the representative stays focused on conversations that matter. Intelligent Routing Keeps Buyers Moving Without Friction Think about the customer experience for a moment. Nobody enjoys repeating the same information three different times after being transferred between departments. It creates frustration before the sales conversation even begins. Modern Automated call handling and routing solve this problem through intelligent decision making. Once AI understands the buyer's responses, it can immediately determine where that conversation should go next. For example, someone asking pricing questions may need an Account Executive. Another example could be someone asking about implementation timelines, who could speak with a Customer Success specialist. Because the conversation history moves with the prospect, the next person joins fully prepared. The buyer does not have to repeat everything from the beginning. That creates a far smoother buying experience while helping internal teams spend less time gathering information that has already been collected. AI Creates Better Timing Across Your Sales Team Timing has always been one of the hardest parts of outbound prospecting. A prospect may answer while your SDR is already speaking with someone else. Someone requests a callback at exactly the wrong time. An inbound lead arrives while representatives are occupied making outbound calls. Without automation, opportunities can disappear surprisingly quickly. Modern AI solves much of that scheduling complexity. When conversations qualify, meetings can be booked automatically. When prospects request another conversation, callbacks are scheduled instantly. When someone becomes sales ready, AI can transfer them immediately to an available representative. That creates a much faster buying experience without forcing SDRs to juggle multiple conversations at once. Why Real Time Call Coaching and Guidance Produces Better Meetings Most sales coaching happens after the conversation has already ended. Managers review call recordings. They point out missed questions. They suggest stronger responses. Everyone agrees to improve next time. That approach certainly helps, but it comes after the opportunity has already passed. Modern Real time call coaching and guidance changes that process completely. Representatives receive helpful recommendations while the conversation is still happening. Imagine speaking with a prospect who mentions hiring twenty new SDRs next quarter. AI immediately recognizes a buying signal. Without interrupting the conversation, it surfaces recommended discovery questions, relevant customer stories, pricing information, and objection handling suggestions directly on the representative's screen. The SDR stays present in the conversation while receiving guidance that normally comes months later during coaching sessions. That shortens learning curves dramatically. Every Representative Has Access to Your Best Sales Playbook One reason experienced salespeople outperform new hires is simple. They have seen hundreds of conversations; they recognize patterns. On top of that, they also know which questions uncover buying intent. New representatives need months to develop those instincts. AI helps close that experience gap much faster. Rather than relying entirely on memory, representatives receive recommendations built from successful conversations across the organization. That creates greater consistency without making conversations sound scripted. Every SDR benefits from knowledge that previously lived only inside the minds of top performers. Coaching Happens While Confidence Is Still High One overlooked advantage of Real time call coaching and guidance is psychological. Cold calling can be emotionally exhausting. After several difficult conversations, even experienced SDRs begin questioning themselves. That uncertainty affects confidence, ultimately affecting the overall communication pattern. In that order, to render massive support, AI provides steady support throughout the day. If a prospect raises a pricing concern, the representative immediately sees recommended responses. If a competitor is mentioned, relevant competitive positioning appears automatically. If discovery questions have been skipped, the system reminds the representative before moving toward scheduling. Those small moments of assistance reduce hesitation. Representatives feel more prepared because they know guidance is available throughout every conversation. That confidence often leads to more natural conversations and stronger meeting quality. Better Coaching Creates Better Data Every conversation teaches something. Buyers ask new questions. Competitors introduce new messaging. Market conditions change. Traditional coaching depends on managers manually identifying those trends. AI analyzes thousands of conversations continuously. Patterns begin appearing much sooner. Sales leaders can quickly identify which objections appear most frequently, which messaging resonates with different buyer personas, and which questions produce the highest meeting conversion rates. That creates a feedback loop where coaching continuously improves because it reflects current buyer behavior rather than assumptions made several months ago. What's the Best AI Outbound Calling Strategy for 2026? This is one of the most common questions revenue leaders are asking today. What's the best AI outbound calling strategy for 2026? Many organizations assume success comes from buying the newest platform with the most impressive feature list. Technology certainly matters; tt simply should not be the starting point. The strongest outbound programs begin with strategy and allow technology to support that strategy. Companies that build a thoughtful outbound process create remarkable results because AI amplifies practices that already work. A successful strategy combines people, AI, data, and workflow into one coordinated system. Build Highly Focused Prospect Segments Large prospect lists often look impressive on paper. They rarely produce impressive conversations. Group prospects according to shared characteristics, business priorities, hiring activity, technologies, company size, and buying signals. The more relevant your messaging becomes, the more naturally AI conversations sound. This is one area where personalization continues outperforming volume. Train AI Around Conversations Rather Than Scripts Many organizations still think in terms of scripts. Buyers rarely follow scripts. Every conversation takes unexpected turns. Train your AI around conversation paths, common objections, qualifying questions, and buying signals. That flexibility allows AI voice agents and virtual sales assistants to respond naturally while keeping conversations moving toward the next logical step. Keep Humans Involved at High Value Moments AI performs repetitive work exceptionally well. Relationship building still belongs to people. Allow AI to qualify prospects, answer common questions, schedule meetings, and gather context. Bring experienced salespeople into conversations where buying decisions become more complex. That partnership creates a stronger experience for both buyers and sales teams. Connect AI With Your Existing Sales Stack One reason AI adoption has accelerated so quickly is that companies no longer need to rebuild their technology ecosystem from scratch. Many AI calling platforms connect directly with CRMs, sales engagement platforms, calendar software, conversation intelligence tools, and analytics systems. This naturally answers another question many organizations ask. How to implement AI calling within your existing sales engagement platform? A couple of things that you can do for a head start. Take them as a general guideline, because we’d want you to improvise for the best long term results… Begin with one outbound team. Connect AI to your CRM. Import one carefully segmented prospect list. Test conversation flows. Review call recordings. Measure outcomes. Refine messaging. Expand gradually after performance becomes predictable. Rolling out AI in phases produces better adoption than attempting a company wide deployment overnight. Appointing a Technology Champion: Is It a Good Decision? Technology champions are bunch of people that are well-versed in any software, it’s overall features and how to use the latest technology. Even if the program comes with tons of automation and self explanatory AI tech stack, sales teams do need training from someone who has hands on experience. A “techie” could be a nominated person from within your company, or they could be someone from outside. In the latter case, external support comes from the same company you bought the software from. Either they do it for free through one or two online meetings, or they charge you extra. If budget is a major concern, then go for an in-house technology champion who has prior experience with similar software etc. Ultimately, it’s your decision, so do whatever it takes to reduce ramp time for the entire team. Measure Business Outcomes Rather Than Call Volume Modern outbound organizations no longer celebrate activity for its own sake. Revenue leaders want conversations that become pipeline. Eventually, it becomes revenue. That means performance reviews should move beyond simple dialing metrics. When leadership begins asking What metrics prove AI outbound calling improves sales performance? , the strongest answers usually include held meetings, qualified opportunities, conversion rates, pipeline contribution, sales cycle length, and revenue generated. Those measurements tell a much more complete story than daily call volume ever could. Confident SDRs Burn Out Less, Here's How Trellus Helps One of the biggest problems with traditional sales coaching is timing. Most coaching happens after the call is over. A manager listens to recordings, points out missed opportunities, shares feedback, and hopes the representative remembers it during the next conversation. Valuable advice arrives after the opportunity has already passed. Modern Real time call coaching and guidance works very differently. Platforms like Trellus provide live coaching while the conversation is happening. Rather than waiting for a weekly review session, representatives receive contextual suggestions the moment they need them. Imagine a prospect asking about pricing, mentioning a competitor, or raising an objection that commonly stalls deals. The platform can surface recommended talking points, objection handling guidance, relevant customer stories, or follow up questions without interrupting the conversation. The representative stays engaged with the buyer while receiving support that feels like having an experienced sales coach sitting beside them. This becomes especially valuable for newer SDRs who are still building confidence. Even experienced representatives have days when conversations do not go their way. Hearing repeated objections or dealing with multiple rejections can affect energy levels and decision making throughout the day. With intelligent guidance available during live conversations, hesitation begins to disappear. Representatives spend less time wondering what to say next and more time listening to the buyer. That creates smoother conversations, stronger discovery, and better qualified meetings. Over time, confidence grows naturally because every conversation becomes another learning opportunity rather than another stressful guessing exercise.

title: Measured in minutes: Helping customers reach the moments that matter most
body_text: When a flight was delayed out of Cleveland, Delta teams across Flight Operations, Airport Customer Service, In-Flight Service, OCC, Reservations & Care and TechOps quickly came together with one goal: keep customers moving safely and minimize impacts to their journey. Through proactive planning, seamless coordination and rapid execution, a ferry flight from DTW to JFK was diverted to recover the CLE-ATL flight, making up valuable time and helping customers stay on track — including the University of Akron softball team traveling to its first NCAA tournament appearance in program history. title: bioAffinity Technologies’ Quarterly CyPath® Lung Sales Double to New Record as Commercial Momentum Continues
summary: CyPath® Lung sales volume for Q2 2026 grows more than 200% year-over-year and 30% over record-breaking prior quarter Growth in Q2 driven by…...
body_text: bioAffinity Technologies’ Quarterly CyPath® Lung Sales Double to New Record as Commercial Momentum Continues July 07, 2026 8:46am EDT CyPath® Lung sales volume for Q2 2026 grows more than 200% year-over-year and 30% over record-breaking prior quarter Growth in Q2 driven by increasing utilization among existing clients and 155% increase in physician offices ordering CyPath® Lung as compared to Q2 2025 SAN ANTONIO--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- bioAffinity Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq: BIAF; BIAFW) , a biotechnology company focused on the need for noninvasive, accurate tests for the detection of early-stage lung cancer and other lung diseases, today announced continued acceleration in commercial sales for CyPath® Lung , its noninvasive lung cancer diagnostic, with more than 200% growth year-over-year. The number of tests sold in the second quarter of 2026 represents an increase of more than 30% over the first quarter of 2026 and more than 200% compared with the second quarter of 2025. "We are at the forefront of a positive change in clinical practice. We believe it is the result of expanding physician familiarity and accumulating clinical evidence as more patients are evaluated with CyPath® Lung and benefit from CyPath® Lung-guided care,” said Maria Zannes, President and Chief Executive Officer of bioAffinity Technologies. “The most encouraging trend goes beyond onboarding new practices — the fact is, physicians who try CyPath® Lung appreciate its benefits and continue to use it. Repeat utilization suggests the test is becoming part of routine clinical decision-making for patients with indeterminate pulmonary nodules." The Company has now performed nearly 3,000 CyPath® Lung tests since commercial launch, reflecting growing physician adoption across pulmonology practices, lung nodule clinics, academic and community medical centers, and Veterans Affairs (VA) facilities. bioAffinity Technologies is executing a commercial strategy focused on increasing utilization of CyPath® Lung among existing clients, expanding its sales footprint in existing markets, strategically entering new markets, and building lasting relationships with physicians. "The number of patients diagnosed with indeterminate pulmonary nodules is expected to grow significantly over the next several years with expanded lung cancer screening and incidental findings from other procedures,” said Gordon Downie, MD, PhD, Chief Medical Officer of bioAffinity Technologies. "The challenge is determining which patients require immediate invasive evaluation and which can be safely monitored. CyPath® Lung is designed to provide clinicians with an objective, noninvasive tool that complements imaging and helps them make more informed decisions while reducing unnecessary procedures and patient anxiety." In published patient case studies , CyPath® Lung has helped detect lung cancer at curative Stage 1A when risk stratification guidelines and other adjunct tests indicated low risk. Conversely, a negative CyPath® Lung result has spared patients with significant comorbidities from invasive, often risky procedures. In a recent interview , a CyPath® Lung patient describes the emotional impact of discovering a pulmonary nodule and explains why she appreciated having a noninvasive testing option. "I was petrified. I was scared to death," she recalls. "I was so thankful that CyPath® Lung was something that I could do that was noninvasive… I just want to shout it from the rafters." bioAffinity Technologies is advancing multiple initiatives that the Company believes will further expand the clinical impact of its proprietary technology platform. These include a large-scale longitudinal clinical study designed to generate additional validation data for CyPath® Lung, expansion into oncology by using CyPath® Lung to monitor lung cancer survivors after treatment, and an R&D pipeline that includes diagnostic tests for asthma and COPD that are designed to help guide personalized treatment with targeted therapies. “We are building on the success of CyPath® Lung to develop noninvasive tests designed to ensure asthma and COPD patients are matched with the most effective treatment for their type of lung disease,” Dr. Downie said. “We continue to develop our automated flow cytometry platform that supports an expanding number of diagnostic tests that we believe can lead to improved lung health for millions of people." The Company expects to report its financial results for the second quarter of 2026 in August. About CyPath® Lung CyPath® Lung by bioAffinity Technologies is a noninvasive test designed to improve the early detection of lung cancer in patients at high risk for the disease. CyPath® Lung uses advanced flow cytometry and proprietary artificial intelligence (AI) to identify cell populations in patient sputum that indicate malignancy. CyPath® Lung incorporates a fluorescent porphyrin that is preferentially taken up by cancer and cancer-related cells. In a published clinical trial of high-risk patients, CyPath® Lung demonstrated 92% sensitivity, 87% specificity, 88% accuracy and 99% negative predictive value (NPV) in detecting lung cancer in patients at high risk for the disease who had small indeterminate lung nodules less than 20 millimeters. The high NPV gives physicians greater confidence that a negative result is truly negative, potentially sparing patients from unnecessary invasive and costly procedures. CyPath® Lung is marketed as a Laboratory Developed Test (LDT) and is not intended for use as a sole diagnostic tool and should be considered alongside other clinical findings. About bioAffinity Technologies, Inc. bioAffinity Technologies, Inc. addresses the need for noninvasive diagnosis of early-stage cancer and other diseases of the lung and broad-spectrum cancer treatments. The Company’s first product, CyPath® Lung, is a noninvasive test that has shown high sensitivity, specificity and accuracy for the detection of early-stage lung cancer. CyPath® Lung is marketed as a Laboratory Developed Test (LDT) by Precision Pathology Laboratory Services, a subsidiary of bioAffinity Technologies. LDTs are overseen under the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA), which are administered by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services. For more information, visit www.bioaffinitytech.com . body_text: View all news Johnson & Johnson Announces FDA Approval for the Dual Energy THERMOCOOL SMARTTOUCH SF Platform 07/08/2026 Download (opens in new window) PDF 256 KB Dual Energy THERMOCOOL SMARTTOUCH SF Platform brings pulse field and radiofrequency energy together in a single catheter. Integrated with the CARTO ecosystem, the platform gives physicians greater versatility to tailor treatment based on patient anatomy and case complexity.i IRVINE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ) today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved the Dual Energy THERMOCOOL SMARTTOUCH SF Platform (DE STSF), an integrated catheter ablation solution that enables electrophysiologists to deliver both radiofrequency (RF) and pulsed field (PF) energy through a single catheter.i Dual Energy THERMOCOOL SMARTTOUCH SF Catheter “The FDA approval of the Dual Energy THERMOCOOL SMARTTOUCH SF Platform is another important milestone in what has been an incredible pace of innovation for our business,” said Michael Bodner, Company Group Chair, Electrophysiology & Neurovascular, MedTech, Johnson & Johnson. “Our goal has always been to put the best possible technologies into physicians’ hands so they can treat increasingly complex cases with confidence. Following a successful introduction in Europe, we’re pleased to rapidly expand access to this technology in the U.S. and continue building on the momentum of one of the most active innovation periods in our history.” Built on the THERMOCOOL SMARTTOUCH SF Platform, which has extensive clinical validation and has treated over one million patients in the U.S., the DE STSF Platform brings pulse field capability to a catheter physicians know and trust.i The DE STSF platform is integrated with the CARTO ecosystem, including advanced mapping, imaging and PF Index guidance, helping physicians confidently deliver energy with precise contact force while supporting a predictable procedure and reproducible workflow. The dual energy capability gives physicians the versatility to use RF or PF energy based on patient anatomy and case complexity.i "Electrophysiologists need technologies that support different anatomies, substrates, workflows and treatment goals," said Dhanunjaya (DJ) Lakkireddy1, M.D., FHRS, MBA, Executive Medical Director, The Kansas City Heart Rhythm Institute. "The Dual Energy THERMOCOOL SMARTTOUCH SF Platform gives electrophysiologists the choice to use RF or PF energy based on the needs of each procedure. Having both capabilities integrated in the CARTO system can help us adapt our approach for more complex cases and plan procedures with greater confidence.” Following FDA approval, first U.S. procedures with the DE STSF Platform are expected to begin this summer as Johnson & Johnson initiates a phased commercial rollout. About Cardiovascular Solutions from Johnson & Johnson MedTech Across Johnson & Johnson, we are tackling the world’s most complex and pervasive health challenges. Through a cardiovascular portfolio that provides healthcare professionals with advanced mapping and navigation, miniaturized tech, and precise ablation we are addressing conditions with significant unmet needs such as heart failure, coronary artery disease, stroke, and atrial fibrillation. We are the global leaders in heart recovery, circulatory restoration, and the treatment of heart rhythm disorders, as well as an emerging leader in neurovascular care, committed to taking on two of the leading causes of death worldwide in heart failure and stroke. For more, visit this website. About Johnson & Johnson At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow and profoundly impact health for humanity. title: 6 Tangible Benefits of Account-Based Marketing (ABM)
summary: Learn the real benefits of account-based marketing. Align sales and marketing around high-value accounts to shorten cycles and increase deal sizes in 2026.
body_text: Book a Demo It wasn’t all that long ago that account-based marketing was a fairly obscure approach practiced only by enterprise sales teams targeting whales at other equally large companies. Today, account-based marketing (ABM) is a widely accepted practice and one that’s used not only by enterprise-level companies but also by mid-sized and small businesses alike. The thing with ABM is that it's not exactly something you can just tip a toe in like you can with something like digital advertising or outbound email. To be successful with account-based marketing, you need to go all in, which means you’ll need buy-in from every stakeholder on your leadership time. And, naturally, they’ll all ask the same thing before signing off: What are the benefits of account-based marketing? That’s the exact question we are going to answer in this guide, diving deep into the six important and tangible benefits of running an ABM playbook: 1. Aligns sales and marketing toward a common goal 2. Allows for a more focused use of resources 3. Creates a more customer-centric experience 4. Opens up a world of personalization 5. Can lead to shorter sales cycles 6. Sets you up for long-term customer relationships Account-based orchestration: Moving beyond ABM 1. Aligns sales and marketing toward a common goal The tension between sales and marketing teams is a thing of legend. It's kind of weird when you think about it. Both teams are, in the end, working toward the goal of closing more customers. There really shouldn’t be any turbulence here. But there often is, and that generally comes from a disconnection between the two teams that work in siloes and only on part of the problem. The sales and marketing problem Marketing works to attract new prospects to the company and capture leads. Sales then takes those leads and tries to convert them into customers. And that’s where the issue emerges. Sales blames marketing for poor quality leads. Marketing blames sales for not doing enough with the leads they’ve generated. But with an account-based marketing approach, this divide disappears. The ABM solution In ABM, you choose the accounts you go after. There is no “ lead generation ” in the traditional sense, as you define from the get-go who your target audience is going to be. Then, sales and marketing must collaborate to attract and close deals. There is no “marketing to sales handoff.” In the early stages of an ABM playbook, marketing might run personalized digital ads, while sales executes outreach via email and LinkedIn. Further down the sales funnel, the sales team might be engaging in demos and presentations while marketing supplements with additional educational email content. Members from each team work in parallel rather than in series, and they work together toward the same goal: closing target accounts. In fact, the alignment between sales and marketing that ABM brings is so strong that some organizations forgo the distinction altogether and merge the two departments into one GTM (go-to market) team: ( Image Source ) 2. Allows for a more focused use of resources One of the biggest problems with the traditional marketing model is that your use of resources is relatively unfocused. Sure, you have a defined target audience and ICPs (ideal customer profiles) that you’re going after. But the truth is that beyond that, your “targeting” is incredibly broad. Most of the people your ad campaigns, emails, and content marketing efforts get in front of aren’t in the market to buy right now, even if they fit your customer persona. Worse, you don’t even know if you’re getting in front of the decision-maker. Consider, for example, a prospect coming across a blog post you’ve written and then promoted on social media. That prospect signs up for a sales demo—great news, a warm lead . But after going through the whole presentation, your salesperson learns that they don’t actually have the authority to buy, and so the whole process needs to happen again with the decision-maker. Account-based marketing flips this on its head. Finding KDMs from day one You know who the key decision makers (KDMs) are in a given organization because you’ve used a tool like Warmly or Demandbase to pull account-level data and build a list of multiple stakeholders that might be involved in the deal. Then, your ABM efforts (be they personalized marketing outreach via LinkedIn InMail or a series of ads via your marketing automation platform) go out to those prospects specifically. All of this means that every dollar you spend on account-based marketing strategies is incredibly focused and spent only on the specific accounts that you want to start a conversation with. 3. Opens up a world of personalization One of the biggest benefits of ABM campaigns as a B2B marketing strategy is that you can run incredibly personalized campaigns. We’re not talking about using the prospect’s name in your email campaigns here. We’re talking: Using advanced marketing tools to deliver personalized ads across multiple platforms Target multiple stakeholders at the same time with a personalized and role-based email copy Using unconventional tactics like direct mail and personalized gifting to attract attention Here’s an extreme example to illustrate my point. When software design firm Intridea targeted Ogilvy as a key account in their account-based marketing campaign, they went as far as uncovering the daily commute of the decision-maker at their soon-to-be new customer and ran a custom billboard on the side of the street. ( Image Source ) 4. Creates a more customer-centric experience A well-executed ABM approach almost always leads to an enhanced customer experience when compared with a traditional marketing playbook. In the traditional marketing approach, every customer sees the same marketing programs and tactics. Sure, the content they see might be tailored to their current stage in the customer journey, but it's very rarely personalized to them specifically. But an ABM experience is all about that specific customer and is customized to individual accounts. As a prospect, all of the content you engage with is personalized to your company and even to you and your role. And when you speak to a member of the sales team, they aren’t giving you a blank slate templated pitch. They know who you are, and what success means for you in your role and at your company, and will deliver a tailored pitch that speaks exactly to those needs. It also blends seamlessly with an omnichannel approach, where you’re targeting multiple stakeholders in the buying committee with the right messaging at the right time via the right channel. That's critical because these days, there are more stakeholders than ever before , so the complexity of the deal has increased exponentially. You need solutions that give you signals as to who’s hot and warm in the committee and when they are thinking about you to know when and how to engage. This customer-centric approach ultimately leads to more effective campaigns that close faster. Speaking of which… 5. Can lead to shorter sales cycles Many advocates of an ABM process claim that it has helped them achieve a shorter sales cycle. ( Image Source ) This is going to be true in many cases, though we should be careful to say that there are a number of different variables here. The target audience you’re going after has a huge impact. Enterprise companies (who are more commonly the target of ABM campaigns) close slower than mid-sized organizations, as they often have large and elaborate buying committees. Your sales process itself also has some cards to play here, as do the specific account-based marketing activities you choose to engage in. On the whole, however, if you: Define your ideal customer profile correctly Build realistic account lists with accurate account data Supplement that with third-party buying intent data Execute well-timed and personalized ABM tactics that speak to ICP needs You should see shorter sales cycles from ABM compared to what you would otherwise see from a non-account-based approach. 6. Sets you up for long-term customer relationships Perhaps the most important of the six account-based marketing benefits discussed here is the fact that you’re building stronger relationships than you would be with a traditional motion. In a traditional marketing model, a given prospect isn’t considered a customer until you actually close the deal. Up until then, they’re just a lead. This inevitably frames all discussions up until contracting as sales conversations. An ABM motion, on the other hand, doesn’t really use the lead/customer division; they’re considered an account from the beginning. And because all of your marketing and sales activities are personalized to that specific account, you’re essentially using that as the starting point of your relationship-building efforts. This relationship is then transferred over to the customer success manager (or key accounts manager, depending on your chosen nomenclature). Their job is to nurture and grow the customer relationship rather than create it, which ultimately has a positive impact on customer retention rates. This distinction is why many account-based marketing teams choose to take a land-and-expand approach. The land and expand model The idea with land-and-expand is that your initial sales efforts aren’t about closing the biggest deal possible. They’re just about getting a foot in the door. You might sell your lowest-value product or most commonly used feature and narrow in on that to get a relationship established and a deal closed. Then, your CSM looks for opportunities to upsell to a more robust plan or cross-sell additional features as the relationship flourishes, the trust your client has for you grows, and they begin to see value from using your product. This is a fantastic tactic to add to your startup sales playbook, as it means you can get a door opened with just a single product or even an MVP and expand revenue from there. Account-based orchestration: Moving beyond ABM Account-based marketing clearly offers a number of important benefits. Most importantly, being a personalized approach, a successful ABM strategy ultimately leads to higher ROI and stronger customer relationships than a traditional marketing motion. While we’re fans of ABM programs in general—as compared to a more traditional alternative—we also believe there’s a better way, one which we call account-based orchestration . Account-based orchestration takes an ABM campaign to the next level and encompasses a more holistic approach that aligns both marketing and sales efforts. ( Image Source ) It incorporates various technologies (many of which are ABM tools), data-driven insights, and a heavy dose of AI and automation to execute at scale without needing a huge team. Read more: The Rise of Account-Based Orchestration in the Age of AI and Automation . We built Warmly to help small and medium-sized organizations access account-based orchestration on an SME budget, combining the best of advanced AI and best-in-class data with well-timed human intervention. With Warmly, you can: Deanonyomize site traffic to know exactly who is on your site and what content they’re engaging with Add identified prospects to an automated omnichannel outreach sequence on LinkedIn and email Capture immediate intent with an AI-led chatbot Get notifications via Slack when it is time for a sales rep to jump in and take over the chat What’s best about Warmly? You can get started for free, right now, without speaking to a sales rep or getting thrown into a sales funnel. Get set up with Warmly today, and start seeing ROI in minutes . Learn how Behavioral Signals tripled their enterprise sales pipeline in just one month using Warmly: How Behavioral Signals sourced $7M in enterprise pipeline since using Warmly . Frequently Asked Questions What is 6 Tangible Benefits of Account Based Marketing (ABM)? 6 Tangible Benefits of Account Based Marketing (ABM) refers to the concepts and strategies covered in this article. Understanding these fundamentals helps B2B teams improve their sales and marketing effectiveness. Why is 6 Tangible Benefits of Account Based Marketing (ABM) important? This matters because it directly impacts pipeline generation and revenue. Teams that master these concepts see better results from their go-to-market efforts. How can I implement this? Start with the strategies outlined above. For B2B teams, combining these tactics with tools like Warmly—which identifies website visitors and automates engagement—can accelerate results. What tools help with 6 Tangible Benefits of Account Based Marketing (ABM)? Several tools can help, depending on your specific needs. Warmly is particularly useful for identifying high-intent website visitors and engaging them before they leave your site. What are the best practices for 6 Tangible Benefits of Account Based Marketing (ABM)? Key best practices are covered throughout this article. Focus on the fundamentals first, measure your results, and iterate based on data rather than assumptions.

title: XBOX celebrates 25 years of play and returns to gamescom
summary: Join XBOX at gamescom 2026 as we celebrate 25 years of play. We’re returning to Cologne, Germany to connect with players from around the world and spotlight many of the incredible games coming soon to XBOX.
body_text: Join XBOX at gamescom 2026 as we celebrate 25 years of play. We’re returning to Cologne, Germany to connect with players from around the world and spotlight many of the incredible games coming soon to XBOX. The XBOX booth will be packed with new worlds to explore, developers to meet, and experiences that showcase what’s next for XBOX. Our booth will feature 25 upcoming games and 140 gaming stations , giving fans the opportunity to go hands-on before they launch. Be among the first to play and see games like Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , Fable , Minecraft Dungeons II , Gears of War: E-Day , METRO 2039 , STRANGER THAN HEAVEN , Alien: Isolation 2 , and more. As XBOX commemorates 25 years of play, gamescom 2026 is our way to celebrate the players and communities who made those many years possible. Attendees can revisit iconic moments, games, and innovations from every generation of XBOX through interactive experiences that honor the memories, friendships, and stories created along the way. That celebration continues with the return of XBOX FanFest , bringing together members of our global community for exclusive experiences and unforgettable moments. Can’t join in person? We’ll be streaming live on YouTube and Twitch , connecting fans around the world with developer interviews, special guests, gameplay reveals, new trailers, and more. It’s all about the games The biggest games of the year will be on XBOX, and many of them will be in our booth ready for you to dive into early. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 takes center stage. Step into the franchise’s signature Core 6v6 Multiplayer on XBOX Series X, where every match showcases the fluid movement and best-in-class ballistics that define Modern Warfare 4 . Whether you’re returning after the Early Access Beta or getting your first taste of the action, this is your chance to experience the next chapter of Modern Warfare Multiplayer firsthand. Gears of War: E-Day brings the first public playable hands-on experience with campaign to gamescom, giving players an early look at the brutal origins of the Locust War and the beginning of the brotherhood between Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago ahead of its October 6, 2026, release. Play Minecraft Dungeons II for the first time. Drop your pickaxe and grab a sword (and a friend) because the foes are tougher than ever – but the loot is worth the battle. Can you fight the crisis? For the first time ever, Fable will have a live demo theater presentation by Playground Games, showcasing live gameplay to the public, taking fans on a Hero’s journey that highlights its smooth and responsive combat. Seamlessly combine melee, ranged, and magical abilities to forge a combat style that feels uniquely your own. Play STRANGER THAN HEAVEN for the first time. Face down fate in the 50-year, action-adventure saga’s demo showcasing the innovative combat system that has you independently control the left and right sides of protagonist Makoto Daito across 3 of the 5 immersive Japanese cities & eras found in the full game. Get hands-on with METRO 2039 for the first time at gamescom ahead of its release in February 2027. Explore, scavenge, and survive the post-apocalyptic ruins of Moscow in the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers 4A Games. Halo: Campaign Evolved lets attendees go hands-on with the faithful yet modernized remake of Halo: Combat Evolved ’s legendary campaign, featuring updated visuals, refined gameplay, expanded combat options, and the iconic ringworld adventure that started it all. Between new Forza Horizon 6 features and partnership collaborations, there is always something new happening in Japan. Players can test their driving skills in the new Drift Attack feature and get a sneak peek at partnership collaborations dropping over the next few months. Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 brings riveting content and announcements from the world of digital aviation, including the first public playable hands-on experience with the National Championship Air Races, giving players a chance to experience the fastest motorsport on earth. There’s so much more to play including Alien Deathstorm , Alien: Isolation 2 , Bad Magpie , The Blood of Dawnwalker , Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse , Crowsworn , Genigods: Nezha, Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy , STAR WARS Zero Company , Terrible Lizards , Turok: Origins , and Valor Mortis . Tune in from home XBOX will bring the show to you with live broadcasts from the heart of the XBOX booth starting at 4pm CEST on Wednesday, August 26 and Thursday, August 27 featuring interviews, special guests, gameplay reveals, new trailers, and more. Tune in on YouTube and Twitch . The show will be available in American Sign Language (ASL) and English Language Audio Descriptions (AD). Select content from the show will be available in additional languages. XBOX Booth Details You’ll be able to find us in Hall 7, booth A-0.61. Thursday, August 27 – 10am to 8pm CEST Friday, August 28 – 10am to 8pm CEST Saturday, August 29 – 9am to 8 pm CEST Sunday, August 30 – 9am to 8pm CEST Our booth will be wheelchair accessible, with XBOX Adaptive Controllers available upon request and select demo stations equipped with adjustable-height desks and monitors. “Here to Help” staff will be on hand to help players with adaptive set ups and our Quiet room and sensory items will be available for players looking for a reduced sensory experience. Additionally, we will provide ASL, BSL and DGS interpreters and English- and German-language Audio Descriptions at our booth from 12-5pm Thursday through Sunday. XBOX FanFest Sweepstakes XBOX FanFest’s next stop is Cologne, Germany on Wednesday, August 26 from 8pm – 11pm CEST at the XBOX booth. Check our official social channels and the official XBOX FanFest website for news about how to enter the sweepstakes for your chance to win tickets.

title: Second-generation AWS Outposts racks now supported in the AWS Asia Pacific (Mumbai) Region
summary: Discover more about what's new at AWS with Second-generation AWS Outposts racks now supported in the AWS Asia Pacific (Mumbai) Region
body_text: Second-generation AWS Outposts racks are now supported in the Asia Pacific (Mumbai) Region. Outposts racks extend AWS infrastructure, AWS services, APIs, and tools to virtually any on-premises data center or colocation space for a truly consistent hybrid experience. Organizations from startups to enterprises and the public sector in and outside of India can now order their Outposts racks connected to this new supported region, optimizing for their latency and data residency needs. Outposts allows customers to run workloads that need low latency access to on-premises systems locally while connecting back to their home Region for application management. Customers can also use Outposts and AWS services to manage and process data that needs to remain on-premises to meet data residency requirements. This regional expansion provides additional flexibility in the AWS Regions that customers’ Outposts can connect to. To learn more about second-generation Outposts racks, read this blog post and user guide . For the most updated list of countries and territories and the AWS Regions where second-generation Outposts racks are supported, check out the Outposts rack FAQs page .
